Requirements Your turret's array deals energy damage.

You've customized your turret to fire explosive blasts of energy. Make a ranged Strike with your turret against a target. Regardless of the result of the attack, additional energy from this shot is expelled around your turret, dealing damage to creatures in your choice of a @Template[emanation|distance:10] around your turret or a @Template[cone|distance:15] originating from your turret. All creatures in the area take damage equal to your turret's ranged Strike with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic|options:area-damage] save against your class DC.
